comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. The inputs and outputs get no family: the module copies whatever is patched into it, so no colour would be true of them. The text fields are LedDisplayTextField children with no ParamWidget, so they have no census position and no note; their contents are saved in the module's own JSON.
